verdict.rationale: Trello is a visual project-management and kanban SaaS, not a coding agent or code-execution environment. Auto-detecting and installing toolchains and dependencies is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence (Power-Ups, REST API, MCP server for connecting Trello to AI tools) shows Trello shipping any such capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
